can_answer: yes: the file records motorist and cyclist deaths per crash and crash dates for the requested years, allowing their annual shares among these two categories to be compared
metric: Annual share of combined motorist-plus-cyclist fatalities attributable to motorists and to cyclists, using summed per-crash killed columns
denominator: For each year, the sum of motorist deaths and cyclist deaths in that year
population: All police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes dated from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; the compared denominator comprises only deaths counted in the motorist and cyclist killed columns

data_check.facts: The 2013-2025 period contains 2,132,218 crashes, with every requested calendar year present and date coverage from January 1 through December 31 in each year. There are 0 NULL crash dates in the file, 0 in-period sentinel dates among 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, 0001-01-01 and 9999-12-31, and 0 missing values in either killed column in the selected population (0 in every year).
data_check.meaning_and_decisions: No in-period crashes are dropped for a missing or default crash date, and no crash rows need to be excluded or separately grouped for missing motorist/cyclist death values. Keep all 2,132,218 crashes, sum both killed columns, and use their combined sum as each year's denominator; disclose that pedestrians and exposure are outside this comparison.

limitations: Shares use only deaths recorded in the motorist and cyclist killed columns, exclude pedestrians and other road-user categories, and do not measure per-trip or per-mile risk; all requested years have full calendar-date coverage, and neither killed column is missing in the selected population.
